title: Membership in the pullback of a protocol input set
statement: Let $f_X : X' \to X$ and $f_Y : Y' \to Y$ be maps, let $R \subseteq X \times Y$, and let $(x', y') \in X' \times Y'$. Then $(x', y')$ lies in the pullback of $R$ along the product map $f_X \times f_Y$ if and only if $(f_X(x'), f_Y(y')) \in R$.
hypotheses_covered: maps $f_X : X' \to X$ and $f_Y : Y' \to Y$
replaced:
For maps $f_X : X' \to X$, $f_Y : Y' \to Y$, a set $R \subseteq X \times Y$, and a pair
$(x', y') \in X' \times Y'$, we have $(x', y') \in \texttt{preimageInputSet}(f_X, f_Y, R)$
if and only if $(f_X(x'), f_Y(y')) \in R$.
